item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - BIGBANG JAPAN DOME TOUR 2014～2015 (1080p HD)
item.description:
BIGBANG JAPAN DOME TOUR 2014～2015 (1080p HD)​


​
・The year 2014 was to commemorate the Memorial Year of Japan debut, 5-year anniversary of BIGBANG. This was also the first-ever back-to-back Japan 5 dome tour from BIGBANG [BIGBANG JAPAN DOME TOUR 2014 ~ 2015 "X"]!!!
・In this extended tour, over 55,000 gathered in Tokyo Dome Japan on December 26 to witness 170 minutes of energizing performances LIVE!!!
・Jamie King had worked on the production of this dome tour. Known to work with Cirque du Soleil and Michael Jackson, Madonna, and many of the artists on tour, such as Rihanna, Jamie King called this "a concert tour of the masters" in one of the most influential in the current music industry!!!

item.title: 【UPSCALED】The Pussycat Dolls - When I Grow Up (Britney's Cameo Version)
item.description:
“When I Grow Up” [2008] was originally intended for Britney Spears, and even members of The Pussycat Dolls confirmed that she filmed a cameo for the music video that was never officially released. This video is an AI-made reinterpretation, imagining what that cameo might have looked like if it had surfaced or leaked over time — a glimpse into an alternate pop universe where Britney was part of this era.
